 if [[ -z "$client" ]]; then
 # Extract first 500 characters of text
 local content=$(pdftotext -l 1 "$f" - 2>/dev/null | head -c 500)
 
 if [[ "$content" == *"Specific Client A"* ]]; then
 client="Client_A"
 elif [[ "$content" == *"Tax Form"* ]]; then
 client="Accounting"
 fi
 fi
}
3. Automated "Watchdog" TriggerCurrently, you have to click the widget. We can make this "Live" so the second a file is saved to /sdcard/Download, your scripts run.Create a new background task:Install the watcher: pkg install inotify-toolsCreate ~/.shortcuts/tasks/live_intake.sh:Bash#!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash
# Monitors Download folder for finished writes
inotifywait -m -e close_write --format '%f' "/sdcard/Download" | while read FILENAME
do
 if [[ "$FILENAME" == *.pdf ]]; then
 bash ~/.shortcuts/move_pdfs_to_intake.sh
 elif [[ "$FILENAME" == *.jpg ]] || [[ "$FILENAME" == *.png ]]; then
 bash ~/.shortcuts/move_images_to_intake.sh
 fi
done
4. Resolving the "Failed Transaction" ErrorThe cmd: Failure calling service package error in your terminal means the Android system service is timing out when Termux tries to talk to it.The Cause: This is almost always the Android Phantom Process Killer.The Fix: You need to disable the child process limit. Run this command in Termux:
/system/bin/device_config put activity_manager max_phantom_processes 2147483647
